QuestInfo.name: Albert's Daughter
QuestInfo.1: When the Black Wings took over #m310000000#, #p2152006#'s only daughter was taken hostage. #p2152006# says he'd like to send her something she might need while she's being held hostage at the Black Wings' headquarters. Go to #b#m310000004##k and find him #b#t4032757##k.\n\n#i4032757# #t4032757# #b#c4032757# / 1#k
QuestInfo.2: You found #t4032757#, which belong to #p2152006#'s daughter.

0.0: My name is #p2152006#. I used to be the Council President who led this town. Of course I'm nothing more than an old man now that the Black Wings have taken over... They rule because of my own ineptitude. I feel so terrible for the townspeople.
0.1: There's but one thing I hope and live for, to see the face of my poor daughter, #b#p2154004##k. When the Black Wings arrived, they took her hostage and I haven't seen her since. I'm told she's alive, but I can't imagine what she's going through!
0.2: She's a hostage, so they'll keep her alive, but I doubt they're taking good care of her. She must be having a terrible time of it. Can you do me a favor? I want to deliver some items to #p2154004#.

yes.0: I assume the Black Wings are feeding her, since she's not dead, but she probably doesn't have anything decent to wear. To think a girl of such a tender age might be dressed in rags! My plan is to ask one of the Watchmen to deliver #t4032757# to her.
yes.1: Unfortunately, the mansion that I and #p2154004# used to live in has been taken over by #p2152007#. I can't get near it. Can you go to the #b#m310000004##k, enter the closet, and bring back #b#t4032757##k? I will reward you as much as I possibly can.

no.0: I see... I can only blame myself for not being able to do anything else other than asking others for help.

1.0: You brought #t4032757#! Thank you! It's so strange. Her clothes are here but #p2154004# is so far away... No, I have no time for tears. I need to get this to that one Watchman...

item.0: Have you not been able to get #t4032757# yet? Please go inside the #b#m310000004##k that #p2152007# has taken over and bring back #b#t4032757##k. Please.
